about: Every point where the mod touches Far Far West (UE 5.8, UE4SS experimental with the official Far Far West signature config). Far Far West's UE4SS config turns off ProcessEvent and Actor tick hooks, so the mod polls on a game-thread timer instead of hooking. verified = in_game once seen working in the running game.

columns.method: string: the engine call the module uses
columns.targets: list:string: class/property/function names or name patterns

rows.purpose: Game time for fire rate, fuses and reloads
Tell the hub from a run so the class picker opens when a run starts
Read mouse and keys every tick (fire held, reload, swap, grenade, turret, picker)
Hitscan bullets, line of sight, grenade flight collision
Every AI-controlled character in the level (Far Far West's enemies)
rows.method: FindAllOf Character, keep those whose Controller IsA AIController and that are alive

rows.purpose: Read an enemy's health so damage can be confirmed and dead enemies skipped
rows.method: Reflect over the actor, its components and AbilitySystemComponent.SpawnedAttributes for a float or GameplayAttributeData property named like Health/HP

rows.purpose: Deal gun/turret/grenade damage the engine way
rows.method: GameplayStatics:ApplyPointDamage(target, dmg, dir, hit, pc, pawn, nil)

rows.purpose: Second damage route if point damage changes no health
Last damage route: lower the probed health value directly, and kill at zero
rows.method: write probed Health (GameplayAttributeData BaseValue+CurrentValue or float); at <= 0 call K2_DestroyActor after SetLifeSpan

rows.purpose: Pure dwarf: Far Far West's own guns and spells stop answering their buttons
rows.method: For every InputMappingContext, UnmapAction on actions whose name matches a block pattern and none of the keep patterns, then RequestRebuildControlMappings
